fixed.explanation: gitDiff always runs `git fetch --depth=1`. In a full clone this turns the repo shallow and cuts history. The fix checks `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` first and adds the depth limit only when the repo is already shallow. A full clone then stays complete, and the diff is still captured.
